axes.model_access: In-house Vidu Q video models (official API docs list viduq3-pro, viduq3-turbo, viduq2-pro, viduq2-turbo, viduq1 and vidu2.0, each with its own duration/resolution/audio capabilities) plus the S real-time interactive line (S2-Avatar, S2-Editing). Users pick model tiers, not raw weights (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web (vidu.cn domestic / vidu.com overseas) plus the open-platform API (`https://api.vidu.com/ent/v2/text2video` and others); generation runs in the vendor cloud, with clients polling a task or receiving a callback (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: No local filesystem access: input images arrive as URLs or Base64, and finished videos come back as download URLs from task queries that users save locally; work history is account-side. Official docs list no local model surface (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Asynchronous tasks: creation returns a `task_id` and state (created/queueing/processing/success/failed), which can be polled or delivered through `callback_url` (three retries on failure). Off-peak jobs generate within 48 hours, auto-cancel with refunds if incomplete, and can be cancelled (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Text-to-video, image-to-video, start-end frame video (`/ent/v2/start-end2video`) and multi-subject reference video (`/ent/v2/reference2video`, including a subject library). The API exposes 1–16 s durations, 540p/720p/1080p, 16:9/9:16/3:4/4:3/1:1 and seed control (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Q-series work is task-based: each generation is independent and characters are reused through reference images or the subject library rather than conversation memory. The S-series real-time avatar explicitly carries short-term memory for continuous interaction, so the two memory surfaces are separate (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Accounts plus subscriptions/credits and an API key (`Authorization: Token ...`). Commercial use of outputs follows the plan and terms, with enterprise API usage under contract; the mainland entry requires real-name and content compliance, with filing Beijing-Vidu-20241125S0003 on record (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: narrative/animation needing character consistency (multi-subject reference), start-end frame transitions, domestic direct access and API batch production. Not fit: model choice/open weights, realistic cinematic blockbusters or offline deployment (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official product docs and API reference for models, tasks and parameters. Multi-subject consistency and start-end interpolation quality need account-level measurement.
unknowns:
- Open weights: official API docs describe closed API access; check the official repository for weight status.
- API quota and concurrency: check the open-platform console plan page.
- Training-use controls: check the official terms and privacy page.
- Account and content policies for the domestic and overseas entries: check each site’s terms.
related: Both domestic video leaders: Kling's ecosystem surface is wide, Vidu's differentiator is multi-subject reference consistency.
Both domestic in-house video entries: Hailuo's entry is light, Vidu's feature surface (reference/first-last frame) is finer.
Upstream/downstream handoff: Vidu's image-to-video often takes FLUX-family images as the first frame.
